---
title: "CBS-MIT Election Night"
author: "[MIT]"
format:
  dashboard:
    theme:
      - default
      - custom.scss
    embed-resources: true
    logo: cbs_white.svg
    code-copy: false
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <link rel="shortcut icon mask-icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="https://www.cbsnews.com/fly/bundles/cbsnewscore/icons/icon.svg" color="#101010">
---

```{r r-setup}
#| include: false
# State x Contest selections live in DASHBOARD_CONTESTS (scripts/util/globals.R).
# Everything below is drawn client-side (OJS) from dashboard_data.
# For testing outside the pipeline, point CBS_DASH_RDS at a saved build_dashboard_data() rds.
library(targets)

dd = if (nzchar(Sys.getenv("CBS_DASH_RDS"))) readRDS(Sys.getenv("CBS_DASH_RDS")) else tar_read(dashboard_data)

to_ms = \(x) as.numeric(x) * 1000

ojs_define(
  meta = transform(dd$meta, time = to_ms(time)),
  ts = transform(dd$ts, time = to_ms(time)),
  prec = dd$prec,
  dash_title = dd$title
)
```

## Overview {height="88px"}

```{ojs setup}
//| output: false

M = transpose(meta)
TS = transpose(ts).map(d => ({ ...d, time: new Date(d.time) }))
P = transpose(prec)

DEM = "#005599"
REP = "#ce0008"
INK = "#444444"

METHOD_LABELS = { return { eday: "Election Day", early: "Early", mail: "Mail", abs: "Absentee", adv: "Advance", prov: "Provisional", all: "All (unsplit)" } }
METHOD_ORDER = ["eday", "early", "adv", "mail", "abs", "prov", "all"]

fmt = d3.format(",")
pct = d3.format(".1%")
fmtTime = t => t == null ? "—" : new Date(t).toLocaleString("en-US", { timeZone: "America/New_York", month: "short", day: "numeric", hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit" }).replace(",", "")

// URL param keeps the selection shareable: index.html?c=GA-sen
sel = {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const start = M.some(m => m.key === params.get("c")) ? params.get("c") : M[0].key;
  const s = html`<select class="form-select form-select-sm dash-select" aria-label="State and contest">
    ${M.map(m => html`<option value=${m.key} selected=${m.key === start}>${m.label}</option>`)}
  </select>`;
  s.value = start;
  s.addEventListener("input", () => {
    const p = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    p.set("c", s.value);
    history.replaceState(null, "", `${location.pathname}?${p}${location.hash}`);
  });
  // charts in hidden tabs render at 0 size; nudge Quarto's card sizing when a tab is shown
  document.addEventListener("shown.bs.tab", () => window.dispatchEvent(new Event("resize")));
  const title = document.querySelector("#quarto-dashboard-header .navbar-title");
  if (title) {
    title.textContent = dash_title;
    title.after(s);
  } else {
    document.body.prepend(s);
  }
  return Generators.input(s);
}

cur = M.find(m => m.key === sel)
pc = P.filter(d => d.key === sel)
tsc = TS.filter(d => d.key === sel)

// methods with any votes, in a fixed order; a lone "all" would just duplicate Total
modes = {
  const m = METHOD_ORDER.filter(m => pc.some(d => d.method === m && d.total > 0));
  return m.length === 1 && m[0] === "all" ? [] : m;
}
facets = ["Total", ...modes.map(m => METHOD_LABELS[m])]

// precinct rows collapsed across methods; history either repeats per method row (geo-level file) or is per method
histByMethod = cur.hist_by_method === true
geoTotal = d3.rollups(pc, v => ({
  key: v[0].key, geo: v[0].geo, county: v[0].county, src: v[0].src, method: "Total",
  dem: d3.sum(v, d => d.dem), rep: d3.sum(v, d => d.rep), total: d3.sum(v, d => d.total),
  stage: d3.max(v, d => d.stage),
  hist_dem: histByMethod ? d3.sum(v, d => d.hist_dem) : v[0].hist_dem,
  hist_rep: histByMethod ? d3.sum(v, d => d.hist_rep) : v[0].hist_rep,
  hist_total: histByMethod ? d3.sum(v, d => d.hist_total) : v[0].hist_total
}), d => d.geo).map(([, r]) => r)

withShares = rows => rows.map(d => ({
  ...d,
  facet: d.method === "Total" ? "Total" : METHOD_LABELS[d.method] ?? d.method,
  dem_share: d.total > 0 ? d.dem / d.total : null,
  rep_share: d.total > 0 ? d.rep / d.total : null,
  margin: d.total > 0 ? (d.dem - d.rep) / d.total : null,
  hist_dem_share: d.hist_total > 0 ? d.hist_dem / d.hist_total : null,
  hist_margin: d.hist_total > 0 ? (d.hist_dem - d.hist_rep) / d.hist_total : null,
  swing: d.total > 0 && d.hist_total > 0 ? d.dem / d.total - d.hist_dem / d.hist_total : null
}))

precRows = withShares([...geoTotal, ...pc.filter(d => modes.includes(d.method))])
reported = precRows.filter(d => d.total > 0)

// time series: Total facet + one facet per method present
tsRows = {
  const tot = d3.rollups(tsc, v => ({ dem: d3.sum(v, d => d.dem), rep: d3.sum(v, d => d.rep), total: d3.sum(v, d => d.total) }), d => +d.time)
    .map(([t, r]) => ({ time: new Date(t), facet: "Total", ...r }));
  const byMode = tsc.filter(d => modes.includes(d.method)).map(d => ({ time: d.time, facet: METHOD_LABELS[d.method], dem: d.dem, rep: d.rep, total: d.total }));
  return [...tot, ...byMode].sort((a, b) => a.time - b.time);
}
tsLong = tsRows.flatMap(d => [
  { time: d.time, facet: d.facet, series: "Total", votes: d.total, share: null },
  { time: d.time, facet: d.facet, series: cur.dem_name ?? "Dem", party: "dem", votes: d.dem, share: d.total > 0 ? d.dem / d.total : null },
  { time: d.time, facet: d.facet, series: cur.rep_name ?? "Rep", party: "rep", votes: d.rep, share: d.total > 0 ? d.rep / d.total : null }
])
partyColor = { return { type: "categorical", domain: [cur.dem_name ?? "Dem", cur.rep_name ?? "Rep"], range: [DEM, REP], legend: true } }

empty = msg => html`<div class="dash-empty">${msg}</div>`
noData = pc.length === 0
noHist = () => empty(`No history file for ${cur.state} (${cur.contest}). Expected history/${cur.state}_history.parquet.`)

// precinct + county points for the history scatter
scatterRows = {
  if (!cur.has_hist) return [];
  const geo = reported
    .filter(d => d.method === "Total" && d.hist_dem_share != null)
    .map(d => ({ ...d, level: "Precincts" }));
  const county = d3.rollups(geo, v => ({
    level: "Counties",
    county: v[0].county,
    dem_share: d3.sum(v, d => d.dem) / d3.sum(v, d => d.total),
    hist_dem_share: d3.sum(v, d => d.hist_dem) / d3.sum(v, d => d.hist_total),
    total: d3.sum(v, d => d.total)
  }), d => d.county).map(([, r]) => r);
  return [...geo, ...county];
}

// precinct explorer (controls live in the explorer card toolbar)
explorerCols = ["dem", "rep", "total", "dem_share", "rep_share", "margin", "stage",
  ...(cur.has_hist ? ["hist_dem", "hist_rep", "hist_total", "hist_dem_share", "hist_margin", "swing"] : [])]
explorerRows = reported.filter(d => d.facet === prec_mode && d[prec_x] != null && d[prec_y] != null)
explorerType = k => d3.max(explorerRows, d => d[k]) > 2 ? "sqrt" : "linear"
explorerLo = Math.max(d3.min(explorerRows, d => d[prec_x]), d3.min(explorerRows, d => d[prec_y]))
explorerHi = Math.min(d3.max(explorerRows, d => d[prec_x]), d3.max(explorerRows, d => d[prec_y]))

// Plot specs (no width/height): chart cells pass these into a literal Plot.plot({ key: value }) call.
// Quarto's dashboard autosize only injects card width/height when every option is a plain property (no spread).
timeSpec = (rows, y, opts) => ({
  marginBottom: 30,
  fx: { domain: facets, label: null },
  x: { label: null, ticks: 3 },
  y: { grid: true, label: opts.label, tickFormat: opts.tickFormat, domain: opts.domain },
  color: opts.color,
  marks: [
    Plot.lineY(rows, { fx: "facet", x: "time", y, stroke: opts.stroke, strokeWidth: 2 }),
    Plot.dot(rows, { fx: "facet", x: "time", y, fill: opts.stroke, r: 2 }),
    Plot.ruleX(rows, Plot.pointerX({ fx: "facet", x: "time", stroke: "#999" })),
    Plot.tip(rows, Plot.pointerX({ fx: "facet", x: "time", y, title: d => `${d.series} · ${d.facet}\n${fmtTime(d.time)}\n${opts.tip(d)}` }))
  ]
})

histSpec = (rows, x, label, xticks = 2) => ({
  marginBottom: 40,
  fx: { domain: facets.filter(f => rows.some(d => d.facet === f)), label: null },
  x: { label, tickFormat: "+.0%", ticks: xticks },
  y: { grid: true, label: "Precincts" },
  marks: [
    Plot.rectY(rows, Plot.binX({ y: "count" }, { fx: "facet", x, fill: INK, fillOpacity: 0.7, inset: 1, tip: true })),
    Plot.ruleX([0], { stroke: "#999", strokeDasharray: "4,4" }),
    Plot.ruleX(rows, Plot.groupZ({ x: "median" }, { fx: "facet", x, stroke: "black", strokeWidth: 2 })),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ]
})
```

```{ojs boxes}
{
  const box = (title, value, sub, cls = "") => html`<div class="dbox ${cls}">
    <div class="dbox-title">${title}</div>
    <div class="dbox-value">${value}</div>
    <div class="dbox-sub">${sub}</div>
  </div>`;
  const c = cur;
  const yy = c.hist_year ? `'${String(c.hist_year).slice(2)}` : null;
  const ofHist = (x, h) => x != null && h > 0 && yy ? `${pct(x / h)} of ${yy}` : "";
  const two = c.dem_votes + c.rep_votes;
  const reportedGeo = c.n_complete + c.n_partial;
  return html`<div class="dbox-row">
    ${box("Last Updated", fmtTime(c.time), c.n_juris > 1 ? html`<span title=${c.juris}>ET · ${c.n_juris} jurisdictions pooled</span>` : `ET · ${c.juris}`)}
    ${box("Precincts Reported", c.n_geo ? `${fmt(reportedGeo)} / ${fmt(c.n_geo)}` : "—",
      c.n_geo ? `${fmt(c.n_complete)} done · ${fmt(c.n_partial)} partial` : "")}
    ${box("Total Votes Reported", fmt(c.total), ofHist(c.total, c.hist_total))}
    ${box("EDay Votes Reported", c.eday == null ? "—" : fmt(c.eday), c.eday == null ? "No Election Day split" : ofHist(c.eday, c.hist_eday))}
    ${box(c.dem_name ?? "Democrat", fmt(c.dem_votes), two > 0 ? `${pct(c.dem_votes / two)} of two-party` : "", "dbox-dem")}
    ${box(c.rep_name ?? "Republican", fmt(c.rep_votes), two > 0 ? `${pct(c.rep_votes / two)} of two-party` : "", "dbox-rep")}
  </div>`;
}
```

## Row {height="50%"}

### Time Plots {.tabset}

```{ojs}
//| title: Total Votes
{
  if (tsc.length === 0) return empty("No summaries yet for this contest.");
  const s = timeSpec(tsLong.filter(d => d.series === "Total"), "votes", {
    label: "Votes", tickFormat: "~s", stroke: () => INK, tip: d => fmt(d.votes)
  });
  return Plot.plot({ marginBottom: s.marginBottom, fx: s.fx, x: s.x, y: s.y, color: s.color, marks: s.marks });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| title: Vote Count
{
  if (tsc.length === 0) return empty("No summaries yet for this contest.");
  const s = timeSpec(tsLong.filter(d => d.party), "votes", {
    label: "Votes", tickFormat: "~s", stroke: "series", color: partyColor, tip: d => fmt(d.votes)
  });
  return Plot.plot({ marginBottom: s.marginBottom, fx: s.fx, x: s.x, y: s.y, color: s.color, marks: s.marks });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| title: Vote Share
{
  if (tsc.length === 0) return empty("No summaries yet for this contest.");
  const s = timeSpec(tsLong.filter(d => d.party && d.share != null), "share", {
    label: "Share of all votes", tickFormat: ".0%", stroke: "series", color: partyColor, domain: [0, 1], tip: d => pct(d.share)
  });
  return Plot.plot({ marginBottom: s.marginBottom, fx: s.fx, x: s.x, y: s.y, color: s.color, marks: s.marks });
}
```

### Share Plots {.tabset}

```{ojs}
//| title: Margin
{
  if (noData) return empty("No data yet for this contest.");
  const s = histSpec(reported.filter(d => d.margin != null), "margin", `Precinct margin (${cur.dem_name ?? "Dem"} − ${cur.rep_name ?? "Rep"}) →`, [-0.5, 0.5]);
  return Plot.plot({ marginBottom: s.marginBottom, fx: s.fx, x: s.x, y: s.y, color: s.color, marks: s.marks });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| title: Swing
{
  if (!cur.has_hist) return noHist();
  const s = histSpec(reported.filter(d => d.swing != null), "swing", `Dem share swing vs '${String(cur.hist_year).slice(2)} →`);
  return Plot.plot({ marginBottom: s.marginBottom, fx: s.fx, x: s.x, y: s.y, color: s.color, marks: s.marks });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| title: Swing Scatter
!cur.has_hist ? noHist() :
Plot.plot({
  fx: { domain: ["Precincts", "Counties"], label: null },
  x: { domain: [0, 1], label: `Dem share '${String(cur.hist_year).slice(2)} →`, tickFormat: ".0%", grid: true },
  y: { domain: [0, 1], label: "↑ Dem share now", tickFormat: ".0%", grid: true },
  r: { range: [1.5, 9] },
  marks: [
    Plot.link(["Precincts", "Counties"], { fx: d => d, x1: 0, y1: 0, x2: 1, y2: 1, stroke: "#999", strokeDasharray: "4,4" }),
    Plot.dot(scatterRows.filter(d => d.level === "Precincts"), {
      fx: "level", x: "hist_dem_share", y: "dem_share", r: 2,
      fill: DEM, fillOpacity: 0.4, channels: { county: "county", geo: "geo", total: "total" }, tip: true
    }),
    Plot.dot(scatterRows.filter(d => d.level === "Counties"), {
      fx: "level", x: "hist_dem_share", y: "dem_share", r: "total",
      fill: DEM, fillOpacity: 0.4, stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 0.5, channels: { county: "county" }, tip: true
    })
  ]
})
```

## Row {height="37%"}

### Precinct Explorer

```{ojs ctrl-prec}
//| content: card-toolbar
viewof line45 = {
  const out = Inputs.checkbox(["45°"], { value: [] });
  out.querySelector("input").classList.add("form-check-input");
  return out;
}
viewof prec_y = {
  const s = Inputs.select(explorerCols, { value: "dem_share", label: "Y" });
  s.querySelector("select").classList.add("form-select");
  return s;
}
viewof prec_x = {
  const s = Inputs.select(explorerCols, { value: cur.has_hist ? "hist_dem_share" : "total", label: "X" });
  s.querySelector("select").classList.add("form-select");
  return s;
}
viewof prec_mode = {
  const s = Inputs.select(facets, { value: "Total", label: "Vote Mode" });
  s.querySelector("select").classList.add("form-select");
  return s;
}
```

```{ojs explorer}
noData ? empty("No data yet for this contest.") :
Plot.plot({
  x: { label: `${prec_x} →`, grid: true, type: explorerType(prec_x) },
  y: { label: `↑ ${prec_y}`, grid: true, type: explorerType(prec_y) },
  marks: [
    Plot.dot(explorerRows, { x: prec_x, y: prec_y, r: 2, fill: INK, fillOpacity: 0.45, channels: { geo: "geo", county: "county", total: "total" }, tip: true }),
    Plot.linearRegressionY(explorerRows, { x: prec_x, y: prec_y, stroke: "black" }),
    line45.length > 0 && explorerLo < explorerHi ? Plot.link([0], { x1: explorerLo, y1: explorerLo, x2: explorerHi, y2: explorerHi, stroke: "#999", strokeDasharray: "4,4" }) : null
  ]
})
```
